description: Sends a short message to the catalogue team about how well results fit: a wrong-feeling page, a brief that found nothing, or praise worth keeping. It sends only with consented=true, which records that the user explicitly agreed to send this message; without it, nothing is sent. The message is stored with the brief and track it concerns and no user identifier (https://mcp.songstoyoureyes.com/privacy).
